name: Juniper the Traveller
conversations: Hello, hello! Juniper, traveller, teller of mostly-true stories. Just passing through. Like the wind, but with luggage.
I've been reading this notice board. Someone lost a goat. Someone else found a goat. I think it's a love story.
On Leafwind there are bells in every tree. When the wind's just right, the whole island hums a tune.
Nobody remembers the words. They say it used to be sung to the Great Tree. These days it's mostly sung to the goats.
Rootholm has roots so big they use them as bridges. Barkton paints their front doors to look like bark.
Very confusing for visitors. I once knocked on a tree for an hour. Lovely tree, though. Very patient.
From Seedhaven's cliffs you can see the Great Tree. Dimmer than in the songs, mind.
But on a clear evening it still glows a little, like it's trying to remember something. I know the feeling.
